payout_quote: For each friend or family member who makes a deposit of at least $1,000, you will both receive $100 in a stock or ETF of your choice subject to the "Terms and Conditions" below.
steps: Have an approved, funded Public Investing brokerage account in good standing
Copy your unique referral link from the Public app (Rewards button > Earn free stock > Copy link)

Share the link with a personal friend/family member who has no Public brokerage account; they must open the account via your link, get approved, and make a successful initial one-time deposit of at least $1,000
Once cleared, claim your reward in the app within 30 days: choose a stock or ETF of your choice worth a notional $100
catches: Reward is a $100 notional-value fractional share of a stock/ETF — not cash; fractional shares are not transferable and have limited voting rights
Cash value may not be withdrawn for 12 months after claiming, else an early withdrawal fee of up to $100 may apply
Friend must make a $1,000+ initial one-time deposit; account must be approved
Cap: up to $500 of rewards through promotions/offers on the Public app — then ineligible for further reward programs
Reward must be claimed within 30 days or it expires permanently
Only personal relationships — no spam, mass emailing, commercial advertising, or public sale of referral codes; violations terminate the account and void referrals
Reported as Other Income on Form 1099-Misc; consult a tax advisor
biggest_catch: The $100 per referral is paid as fractional stock/ETF shares, not cash — and you cannot withdraw the cash value for 12 months without risking a fee of up to $100.
eligibility: Existing Public Investing members with a funded brokerage account in good standing; referees must be new US residents with a direct personal relationship to the referrer
timing: Public alerts you when cleared to claim; claim within 30 days; withdrawal hold of 12 months

numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($100 notional stock/ETF per referral); time: copying/sharing referral link est. 5-15 min active
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Public alerts you when cleared to claim; claim within 30 days; withdrawal hold of 12 months — structural: the bonus requires a 12-month funding/balance hold before it is even earned.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 30-day payout window is the binding constraint after qualification — nothing in the terms shortens it; compress the qualification leg instead.
The 12-month hold is structural — this route cannot pay fast under any reading of the terms.
